headline: DevOps / DevSecOps Engineer — AWS · Terraform · Kubernetes · Cloud Security
summary: DevOps/DevSecOps engineer running production AWS infrastructure for two enterprise clients: security, compliance and cost work across a multi-account AWS organisation, and end-to-end DevOps for a multi-environment Amazon EKS platform. Hands-on with Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD, CSPM, SIEM and observability. Preparing for CKA and CKS.

experience.progression: Trainee (Jul 2025) → Junior DevOps Engineer (Oct 2025) → DevOps Engineer

engagements.title: Suzuki Digital — DevSecOps & DevOps, AWS multi-account
highlights: Wrote Terraform infrastructure-as-code to consolidate the client's AWS organisation from 70+ accounts to 47 so far (target: 15), reducing management and security overhead.
Part of a 5-member team that cut AWS spend from $100K to $90K per month (~$120K/year), targeting $80K by Jun 2026.
Run cloud security posture management with AWS Security Hub and GuardDuty; built a SIEM on Wazuh and CloudWatch with ZenDuty alerting.
Operate CrowdStrike Falcon, Palo Alto NGFW, Zscaler, OpenVPN, ECR image scanning, KMS, Secrets Manager and IAM controls.
Integrated SonarQube code-quality checks and Trivy container image scanning into the CI/CD pipeline to catch vulnerabilities before deployment.
Supported CIS Benchmark, ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance across the AWS organisation.

engagements.title: Flipspace — DevOps, multi-cloud (GitHub · Azure Pipelines · AWS)
highlights: Started on CSPM in Oct 2025; expanded to full DevOps ownership from Dec 2025.
Manage Amazon EKS clusters and Couchbase across dev, staging and production, all provisioned with Terraform.
Built the observability stack from scratch: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki and CloudWatch.
Run CI/CD on Azure Pipelines and monthly production releases; handle on-call and incident response.
Manage Route 53, ALB/NLB and Nginx traffic routing; added ECR lifecycle policies to control image storage.

projects.name: Multi-cloud Infrastructure as Code
projects.summary: Terraform monorepo with isolated state per provider, a single Makefile entry point and remote state in OCI Object Storage.
highlights: One state file per provider, so any provider can be planned, applied or destroyed on its own.
Placed workloads across five providers' free tiers after verifying limits in provider docs; runs at $0/month.

projects.name: Dohra — local class recorder
projects.summary: Open-source Chromium extension that records a class playing in a browser tab and transcribes it on your own computer — no bot joins the meeting and nothing is uploaded.
highlights: Go companion running whisper.cpp for live local transcription, including Hinglish in Roman script.
Signed releases with one-click self-update, subtitles, search across transcripts and bookmarks.

projects.name: DevOps Assessment Platform
projects.summary: Online exam platform with live invigilation, containerised with Docker Compose; hosted on EC2 for a campus hiring drive at JBIT.
highlights: Live invigilation with camera and screen capture.
Fully containerised with Docker Compose for one-command deployment.

projects.name: Secure Approval Pipeline
projects.summary: Single-use approval links served by a Cloudflare Worker; the automation server stays off the internet and polls, so no credentials are exposed.
highlights: The automation server never accepts inbound traffic.
Each approval link works exactly once.

projects.name: This portfolio
projects.summary: A static, multi-theme portfolio with a points game, a Git-based admin panel and a learning site — built on Astro and served by Caddy from an always-free OCI VM.
highlights: One content model rendered by three entirely different themes.
Content edited in an admin panel; every save is a Git commit that CI builds and deploys.
